mutation_note: Every mutation was applied to the working tree, the named suites were run with bytecode caching disabled, the expected failure was observed, and the source was restored; a final restore check runs the contract suite, and an interrupt or kill restores the file too. A mutation whose anchor no longer matches the source is reported as SKIP and counted as a failure, so a stale harness cannot inflate this list.

review.decision_source: five independent reviews of G03, each followed by remediation and re-measurement
defects_found_while_remediating: An edit adding the recorded-outcome branch to the fixture streaming path silently did not land because a later assertion in the same script aborted before the write; the regression test caught it immediately and the branch was reapplied.
Six mutation anchors went stale when the shared readers were factored out; each was re-anchored on the current source and re-measured rather than counted as a pass.
round_5_defects: HIGH: FixtureTransport.stream() never read RecordedExchange.outcome, so a capture recording HTTP 429 with no tokens served replayed as an accepted sample carrying a clean stop and billed token counts. Both adapters now honour the recorded outcome.

HIGH: _candidate_keys yielded the repeat-pinned endpoint-unqualified key unconditionally, so one capture became an accepted sample for every endpoint in the campaign. Both unqualified keys now obey the same guard.

MEDIUM: check_requested_settings reported a hardcoded requested=True for stream while the module's own reader reports the request's value; the recorded path and the capability path now read the same way.

MEDIUM: ZenAdapter.stream() dropped the unsupported tuple it had computed on the no-fixture branch and dropped the recorded Retry-After on the failure branch, so the streamed path retried differently from complete(). Both are now carried.

MEDIUM: the two catalog normalizers disagreed on max_context, supports_logprobs, name and owned_by, so one payload produced two snapshots and two digests. Both now share one alias reader, one capability reader, one context reader and one label reader.

MEDIUM: with no clock anywhere, the SSE frame index was published under a seconds field, writing first_content_seconds = 0.0 into every streamed artifact. Timings are now recorded only from measured pacing, so a replayed capture records no durations.
LOW: UnsupportedSetting.requested was serialized verbatim, so a stop sequence carrying operator-authored prompt data bypassed the declared-secret mechanism used by every other serialized field.
A test for the unqualified repeat key asserted nothing because its task id never matched the capture; it now uses the capture's benchmark and pins the precondition.

supersede_reason: This record supersedes the four earlier G03 attempts, all of which recorded review_decision PENDING and are retained unchanged. Five independent reviews of G03 returned FAIL, finding 9, 16, 9, 8 and 7 defects (49 in total). The two most serious in the last round were that FixtureTransport.stream() ignored a recorded failure and replayed its frames as an accepted sample with a clean stop and billed token counts, and that the repeat-pinned transcript key was endpoint-unqualified yet escaped the ambiguity guard, turning one capture into an accepted sample per endpoint. All 53 mutations below were applied, observed to fail the named suites with bytecode caching disabled, and restored.
